about: Neutral demo projects for the preview harness (record.py imports them into a throwaway engine). No real people, no real paths: {projects} becomes the sample engine's temporary projects folder. demo_status, demo_claims, demo_evidence and demo_questions are read by record.py and removed before import.

plans.title: Docs site v1
plans.brief: First public docs site: a static site with a getting-started guide, an API reference generated from the code, and a deploy to the team's preview host.

nodes.title: Pick the static site generator
nodes.goal: Compare two static site generators on build time, search support and theming, and write the choice to docs/decisions/ssg.md.

nodes.title: Write the getting-started guide
nodes.goal: Write content/getting-started.md: install, first project, first deploy, each step with a command to copy.

deps.crosses: the chosen generator and its folder layout

nodes.title: Generate the API reference
nodes.goal: Run the reference generator over src/ and write one page per public module under content/reference/.

nodes.title: Deploy a preview
nodes.goal: Build the site and deploy it to the preview host; write the preview URL to deploy/preview.txt.

nodes.title: You review the preview
nodes.goal: Open the preview, read the guide end to end and say whether v1 can go live.

check.prompt: I read the preview and v1 can go live

plans.title: Docs site v2
plans.brief: Second version of the docs site: new information architecture, full-text search, a dark theme, versioned docs and a launch checklist. Everything ships behind the preview host until the launch gate passes.

nodes.title: Audit the current pages
nodes.goal: List every page of v1 with its word count, last edit and monthly visits into content/audit.csv, and flag pages with no visits in 90 days.

nodes.title: Draft the new navigation
nodes.goal: Propose a new sidebar of at most seven top-level sections in content/nav.yml, using the audit to merge or drop thin pages.

nodes.title: You approve the navigation
nodes.goal: Read the proposed navigation and approve it or ask for changes.

check.prompt: The navigation in content/nav.yml is approved

nodes.title: Move pages to the new structure
nodes.goal: Move each page to its new section with a redirect from the old URL; write the redirect map to deploy/redirects.json.

nodes.title: Set up the search index
nodes.goal: Add a build step that writes a full-text index of every page to public/search-index.json, with titles weighted above body text.

nodes.title: Build the search box
nodes.goal: Add a search box to the header that opens results as you type, keyboard first (slash to focus, arrows to move, Enter to open).

nodes.title: Search results page
nodes.goal: Add a /search page that shows ranked results with the matching sentence highlighted and a filter by section.

nodes.title: Dark theme tokens
nodes.goal: Define light and dark colour tokens in src/styles/tokens.css that pass WCAG AA for body text and links.

nodes.title: Theme switcher
nodes.goal: Add a light / dark / system switch to the header that remembers the choice and never flashes the wrong theme on load.

nodes.title: Code block styling
nodes.goal: Restyle code blocks for both themes with a copy button and line highlighting.

nodes.title: Versioned docs
nodes.goal: Publish v1 docs under /v1/ and the new docs at the root, with a version picker in the header.

check.run: npm run build && npm run docs:versions -- --check

nodes.title: Link check
nodes.goal: Run the link checker over the built site; no broken internal links and no redirect chains longer than one hop.

nodes.title: Launch checklist
nodes.goal: Write deploy/launch.md: analytics, sitemap, robots, redirects, search smoke test and a rollback step.

nodes.title: You sign off the launch
nodes.goal: Walk through the launch checklist on the preview host and say whether v2 can go live.

check.prompt: I walked the launch checklist and v2 can go live

demo_evidence.N12: npm run linkcheck exited 1: 3 broken internal links (/guides/deploy#preview, /reference/cli#flags, /faq#billing).

demo_questions.prompt: The search results page is built. Open it on a phone and say whether the highlighted sentences read well.

plans.title: Onboarding email series
plans.brief: A five-email welcome series for new trial users: one message per day, each with a single action, measured by trial-to-paid conversion.

nodes.title: Outline the five emails
nodes.goal: Write emails/outline.md with one line per email: day, subject idea and the single action it asks for.

nodes.title: Draft the copy
nodes.goal: Draft all five emails in emails/drafts/, under 120 words each, every one ending with one button.

nodes.title: Build the templates
nodes.goal: Render the drafts into responsive HTML templates and check they pass the email linter.

nodes.title: Set up the send schedule
nodes.goal: Configure the day 0-4 schedule in the mail tool's config file and dry-run it against a test list.

nodes.title: You approve the series
nodes.goal: Read the five emails as a trial user would and approve the series.

check.prompt: I read all five emails and the series is approved
